[CR CR0805r1 for 38.423] Reason for change: In §9.2.3.109, the size of the PC5 QoS Flow List IE is defined to be 2048 (maxnoofPC5QoSFlows). However, ASN.1 defines maxnoofPC5QoSFlows to be 2064. This discrepancy needs to be resolved. Summary of change: A NOTE is added to both, the tabular and the ASN.1 definition of the PC5 QoS Flow List IE to say that the size of the List shall never exceed 2048 items. Impact Analysis: Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because it introduces a limit to the size of the PC5 QoS Flow List IE only. The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects only the it size of the PC5 QoS Flow List IE. The CR is does n
